mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months where UNRATE exceeds 4.0, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a weakening demand environment that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC for condition is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts Federal Reserve rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0, or Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over three months signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-demand regime with housing starts exceeding 1600 and consumer spending (RSAFS) above 700,000 million dollars, economic growth accelerates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1600 and RSAFS > 700000, or Rank IC for condition is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and rise in CPI inflation signals stagflationary monetary policy dilemmas that trigger equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.01.
